fusions.name: Feint Swipe
fusions.desc: Sends a swat that deals 9 damage to the first enemy it meets. Each hit has a 40% chance of leaving the target [Blunted] for 6 seconds. Costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Sucker Punch
fusions.desc: A sudden blow that deals 30 damage, always a critical hit, and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Turned Aside
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source instead, and your armour rises by 15%.

fusions.name: Feigned Limp
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 35%, a shield worth 30% of your maximum health closes over you for 6 seconds. Once every 40 seconds. Your dodge chance rises by 8%.
